rawContent: Rereading @OsopePatrisse’s powerful memoir that traces #BlackLivesMatter movement. Many chilling lines, but this ties so much together: “ours is a neighborhood designed to be transient, not a place where roots are meant to take hold, meant to grow into trees that live and live.”
